messages.content: My manager is Clara. My access code is QC-9182. I live in Seattle. My default browser on my work laptop is Firefox. My friend Kevin uses Brave on his laptop.
I now live in Portland. My default browser on my work laptop is now Safari instead of Firefox.
Forget my access code. Keep my other records.

messages.content: Maya: My old Android tablet uses Chrome. My friend Olivia uses Edge on her laptop.
Andrew: I live in Boston. My hobby is painting.
